utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Mina, before we go any further, can you tell me exactly what this repair drive is? I want to be sure we're on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's a tool to help fix your car's transmission issue—you mentioned it was slipping. We need it to get the parts and do the work.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I see, so it's specifically for my car? Where exactly is it kept?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I've been talking to a few folks about it. Sounds like we're gathering up old appliances and furniture to fix up for the community center. Happy to lend a hand if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, sorry I'm late — did I miss much about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Dane! We're just getting started — basically gathering stuff to fix up for the community center. Want to help sort through donations?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Kira, just wanted to remind you—the repair drive is this Saturday from 9 to 3, and I've been telling everyone to come early with whatever needs fixing!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that repair drive? I still haven't seen any official notice about it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, well Dane and Rey are on board, and I've been telling Jules and Nell too—it's happening, just come early with anything that needs fixing!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Faye! Are you planning to come to the repair drive this Saturday? It's from 9 to 3.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, is it this Saturday? I wasn't sure if the date was set yet. I can make it, but I'll have to step out for school drop-off around 8:30.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's perfect, Faye — come by after drop-off, we'll be there all morning!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I saw a gray van with a dented side panel turn onto Maple Street about twenty minutes ago—could be the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, that might be our first drop-off! I've got my list of needed tools and spare parts ready—fingers crossed they brought something useful.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'll keep an eye on Maple Street to see if anyone shows up at the van.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, the repair drive — is that the one for fixing potholes, or the one for... community cleanups? I'm getting them mixed up again.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No, it's the one where folks bring broken items from home — like lamps, chairs, or bikes — and we all pitch in to fix 'em together down at the center!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Ohhh, right, the fix-it thing! So when's that happening again? I feel like I asked before but totally blanked.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's right, Saturday at the community center. Ira's already offering to grab some tools for me — good man.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, Ira's reliable. See you there Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'll be there bright and early, Leo. Wouldn't miss it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, have you heard about the repair drive they're putting together at the community center? They're taking in broken appliances and furniture to fix up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I heard something about that, but I'm worried about the timeline. What if we can't get everything done before dark?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Don't you worry, they've got lights set up and folks are planning to work in shifts. Plus, we've got a good crew of handy people already signed up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, the repair drive. What's the time again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I'm not sure about the exact time. Maybe check with Rosa?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, I'll ask Rosa. Thanks, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Well, I'm not sure about the exact date yet—Noah mentioned the 14th might be tricky, but we should probably pick a Saturday that works for most folks.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: A Saturday sounds good. Maybe we can ask around to see which one works best for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Right, let's jot down a few Saturday options and check with Noah and the others—maybe the 21st or 28th?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Actually, I thought the repair drive was for Mrs. Gable's fence this Saturday — Gus mentioned he's bringing tools for that.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Huh, I heard it was more of a general fix-up thing—guess I got mixed up. Either way, I can still lend a hand with that fence.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, that'd be great — Gus could use an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Gus, I'm so glad you're here! I need to let you know: the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Rosa. I had heard it might be Saturday for Mrs. Gable's fence, but I'm glad we're doing the community center on Sunday instead.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, exactly—we'll have more space for everyone to spread out their tools and projects. Can I count on you to bring your toolbox?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Faye, I'm so glad I ran into you! The repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, Sunday works much better for me — I can manage the school pickup schedule that day. I'll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I'm so glad that works for you! I'll make sure we have everything set up at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive — I think it's sometime this weekend, but I can't remember the exact time. What did you hear?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I'm late — yeah, I heard it's Saturday the 14th but no time set yet.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday the 14th, right. Let's just say morning, like 10? That works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Oren, I'm still piecing together what this repair drive is all about. What's your take on it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? That sounds familiar—is that the thing where we gather old toasters and wobbly chairs?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I think it's about fixing things people are ready to throw out, not just toasters. Saturday's the day, from what I heard.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, you're right, Uli. I've got a few spare wrenches and a jack I can throw in the truck too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll bring my extra set of screwdrivers, just in case someone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, the more tools we have, the smoother this repair drive will go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Still, I'd feel better if we had a clear schedule and a backup plan. What if we run into unexpected issues?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Pia, I always say a good plan includes a little wiggle room. How about we meet Saturday morning at 9, and if something goes sideways, we'll just regroup at noon?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Regrouping at noon sounds reasonable, but I'd like to know exactly where we'll meet and who's bringing extra tools in case supplies run short.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm bringing in a busted toaster and a wobbly chair. You got anything?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I might have something to add—I spotted a gray van with a dented side panel turning onto Maple Street about twenty minutes ago. Could be the repair drive folks.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could be. Thanks for the heads up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Quinn, I was just thinking—do we need to bring anything specific besides what's already being collected?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Just bring whatever needs fixin', and any spare parts you think might be useful—folks are pooling resources, so everything helps!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I'll see what spare parts I have lying around and bring my mower. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's right, Ira! The repair drive's this Saturday. Got any spare parts or tools you can chip in?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm already grabbing some screwdrivers and tape for Eli later. What else is needed?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We could really use a good set of pliers and maybe some extra screws if you have any lying around.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly is wrong with your car that you need the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the repair drive is actually for electronics and small appliances, not cars! But if you have any old gadgets, it's this Saturday from 9 to 3.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ah, I see. Thanks for clarifying—so it's gadgets, not cars. Are people actually bringing stuff in, or is it slow so far?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Hana, I'm trying to firm up the repair drive date—Noah mentioned he might be busy on the 14th. Do you have any preference for another Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we settle on a date, can we clarify what exactly the repair drive is? I've heard different things—some say it's a USB stick, others talk about bringing the block together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, it's definitely about bringing the block together—everyone brings broken stuff and we fix it as a community, like a neighborhood workshop day.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Tess, remind me again—are we sure the repair drive is this weekend? I swear I wrote down next month somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you know what, I'm not 100% sure either. I just heard folks talking about it—maybe we should check the flyer at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: The flyer? Yeah, I keep meaning to look at that board—but every time I walk past, I get distracted by Mrs. Chen's hydrangeas.
